map.商标规费 = 基础规费 × 类别数 + 超项费；纸质申请首类 300 元（含 1: Official trademark fee = base fee × number of classes + extra-item fee; ¥300 for the first class on paper, covering 10 items, or ¥270 electronically, with ¥30 for each item beyond 10; renewal ¥500 electronically, change ¥250, transfer ¥500 and opposition ¥500, with extra classes and items added under the current schedule.
map.每个类别指定商品/服务项数: Items of goods / services per class
map.商标注册（1类10项内）: Registration, 1 class with up to 10 items
map.注：以上为官方费用，代理费另计（一般500-2000元/件不等）；商标有效期10: Note: the above are official fees only, with agency fees charged separately, generally ¥500-2,000 per case; a trademark is valid for 10 years and may be renewed within the 12 months before expiry
map.申请商标注册前，按类别数与商品项数估算官费。: Before filing, estimate the official fee from the number of classes and items.
map.每类限定 10 个商品/服务项目，超出每个加收规费。: Each class allows 10 items of goods or services, with a fee for each item beyond that.
map.续展、转让、变更、异议等不同类型费用不同。: Renewal, transfer, change and opposition each carry different fees.
map.商标注册规费 300 元/类（限定 10 个商品/服务项目），未超项则官费 30: The registration fee is ¥300 per class covering 10 items of goods or services, so with no extra items the official fee is ¥300.
map.同 1 类 15 个商品：300 + 超 5 项 × 30 元 = 450 元；: 15 items in one class: 300 + 5 extra items × ¥30 = ¥450; the renewal fee is about ¥500 per class, subject to the latest notice.
map.官费只是申请成本，核准与否取决于近似查询与审查；建议委托代理做近似检索提高成功率: The official fee is only the cost of filing; whether it is approved depends on the similarity search and examination, so an agent should be instructed to run a similarity search.
map.变更和续展收费一样吗？: Do changes and renewals cost the same?
map.不一样，变更、续展、转让、异议各有规费标准，且网上申请与纸质申请、集体/证明商标: No. Change, renewal, transfer and opposition each have their own fee standards, and rates differ between online and paper filing and for collective or certification marks; the official website governs.
